question: Reinhard has lots of blessings, but is there any limit to the number of blessings that one person can have? Also, at the current stage, how many blessings does Reinhard have?
answer: There's no upper limit to the number of blessings. At the current stage, if you include the silly stuff too, it turns into an enormous number, so even the author hasn't decided on it. I don't think I'll pick a number in the future, either.
